skills.name: Revive
skills.description: When this creature hits 0 HP, if <DM created condition>, it is revived at 50% HP.

skills.name: Tunneler
skills.description: This creature lives deep, deep beneath, and attacks from the earth.

skills.name: Gamemaster
skills.description: This creature puppets others to its will.

skills.name: Shapeshifting
skills.description: Has a human form.

skills.name: Terraforming
skills.description: Create traps in the creature's territory. Each one costs 1 Mana.

skills.name: Magical tap
skills.description: All creatures associated with this creature have MAG enabled.

skills.name: Heal (Monster)
skills.description: Heal an amount of HP = to 1/5 of your MAG stat within a radius of ft = to your MAG. Costs 5 Mana.

skills.name: Antimagic
skills.description: All Magic cast within a radius = to this creature's MAG is invalidated, unless the Power of the caster is twice this creature's Power.

skills.name: Boss Weapon
skills.description: +40% to skill. Drops special loot.

skills.name: Manipulator
skills.description: This creature will do all it can to manipulate its targets using their emotions.

skills.name: Multiattack
skills.description: This creature acts twice per turn if the action is an attack.

skills.name: Petrification
skills.description: When this creature's attack hits, make a Resist roll or become petrified.

skills.name: Flying
skills.description: This creature can fly.

skills.name: Semiaquatic
skills.description: Can breathe underwater and in air.

skills.name: Sharp
skills.description: Whenever this creature is successfully melee attacked, it deals damage = to its Defense.

skills.name: Defensive dealer
skills.description: Deal damage = to Defense stat, not Attack.

skills.name: Multiattack
skills.description: This creature acts twice per turn if the action is an attack.

skills.name: Decay
skills.description: When this creature harms another creature, they take additional damage = to 1/5 of Attack (minimum 1) for a # of turns = to Attack.

skills.name: Swallow
skills.description: Any melee attack against this creature that fails results in the attacker being swallowed up. They take damage = to the creature's attack until they can escape.

skills.name: Disease
skills.description: Any creature successfully injured by this creature becomes sick.

skills.name: Vampirism
skills.description: When this creature bites, it can regain HP = to 1/2 damage dealt.

skills.name: Semiaquatic
skills.description: Can breathe underwater and in air.

trait.name: Reproduces using humans in some way

skills.name: Regrow
skills.description: If a limb is severed, sacrifice 2 HP to regrow it.

skills.name: Parasitic
skills.description: This creature roots into its host, slowly killing it.

skills.name: Poison
skills.description: When this creature successfully attacks, they poison the target. Poisoned targets take 1 damage every turn for a # of turns = to the poisoner's Defense.

skills.name: Hypnosis
skills.description: On a successful Power vs Resist check, the opponent is charmed. This charm lasts until they are injured.

trait.name: Drops prey from high height to kill

skills.name: Mana lust
skills.description: Attacks done by this creature steal Mana = to the amount of damage dealt.

Light.name: Heal
Light.description: Heal an amount of HP = to 1/5 of your MAGIC stat on touch. Costs 5 Mana.

Light.name: Light mote
Light.description: Create light in a radius of 30 ft. Costs 1 Mana.

Light.name: Seal
Light.description: Seal a creature in glowing chains of light. Costs 10 Mana. Contested Power vs target Resist per turn to maintain.

Light.name: Purify
Light.description: Deal light damage = to your Power. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 2 Mana.

Light.name: Halo
Light.description: Shroud yourself in light magic, healing 4 HP in a radius of 5 ft every turn for 10 turns. Costs 5 Mana.

Darkness.name: Destroy
Darkness.description: Deal damage = to your Power. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 1 Mana.

Darkness.name: Darkness
Darkness.description: Create darkness in a radius of 30 ft. Costs 1 Mana.

Darkness.name: Curse
Darkness.description: Curse a creature. For every turn your Power wins against their Resist, they will be confused, unable to act except to take random actions. Random action d4: 1- attack self, 2- wander aimlessly, 3- do nothing, 4- attack random nearby target.

Darkness.name: Shadow stalker
Darkness.description: Enter someone's shadow. You are hidden until you leave. Costs 10 Mana.

Darkness.name: Vacuum
Darkness.description: Obliterate the air in a radius = to your Power. Costs 2 Mana.

Darkness.name: Hide
Darkness.description: Obfuscate your presence. Lasts until you move. Costs 2 Mana.

Fire.name: Create flame
Fire.description: Light a small flame, like a lighter would. No Mana cost.

Fire.name: Fireball
Fire.description: Cast a fireball that goes 30 ft forward and hits all targets within its path for damage = to your Power. Costs 5 Mana.

Fire.name: Manipulate flames
Fire.description: Manipulate flames in a radius of ft = to your Magic stat.

Fire.name: Flame arc
Fire.description: Create flames in a burst originating from your body and going out in all directions for 30 ft, dealing damage = to your Power to all targets.

Water.name: Create water
Water.description: Create a small amount of water, enough to fit into a cup. No Mana cost.

Water.name: Rain of Icicles
Water.description: Create a # of icicles = to your Power. Each deals damage = to 1/2 your Power, rounded down. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 4 Mana.

Water.name: Fog
Water.description: Create a thick fog in a 100 ft radius. All creatures within have to succeed on a Perception task to take their actions. Costs 2 Mana.

Water.name: Manipulate water
Water.description: Manipulate water in a radius of ft = to your Magic stat.

Water.name: Water bindings
Water.description: Grapple a target. They may initiate a Power vs Strength check every turn to get out. Costs 2 Mana.

Water.name: Sublimate
Water.description: Boil the blood within a living target on touch, dealing damage = to Power, ignoring Resistances. Costs 10 Mana.

Earth.name: Terraform
Earth.description: Manipulate a square footage of earth = to your Power stat. Costs 2 Mana. Rocks have HP = to how much square footage they are before crumbling.

Earth.name: Earth armor
Earth.description: By touch, grant someone additional damage resistance = to your Power. Lasts for 10 minutes. Costs 3 Mana.

Earth.name: Sharpen edge
Earth.description: Sharpen metal to a razor edge, granting it additional damage = to your Power for a # of uses = to 1/2 your Power rounded down. Costs 4 Mana.

Earth.name: Catapult
Earth.description: Fling rock in the air, dealing damage = to your Power. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 2 Mana.

Earth.name: Influence creature
Earth.description: Influence a creature whose Intelligence is lower than your Magic. They can obey minor commands, such as attack, sit, and carry, but will not harm themself and will still prioritize their own instincts. Costs 3 Mana.

Earth.name: Venom strike
Earth.description: Adds poison to a weapon attack. This poison reduces the opponent's Physical Damage Resistance by your Power, minus their Poison Resistance, for 1 minute. Costs 2 Mana.

Wind.name: Air pocket
Wind.description: Create a pocket of air in a radius = to your Power. Lasts 10 minutes. Costs 3 Mana.

Wind.name: Wind Blade
Wind.description: Slash with a blade of wind, dealing damage = to your Power. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 2 Mana.

Wind.name: Tornado
Wind.description: Create a swirling vortex, pulling all those in a radius = to your Magic who fail a Constitution roll inside for as many turns as they fail a Power vs Strength check. Costs 5 Mana.

Wind.name: Levitation
Wind.description: Float a # of feet = to your Power off the ground. Lasts 10 minutes. Costs 2 Mana.

Wind.name: Speed Boost
Wind.description: Double movement speed for those in a 5 ft radius next to you for 10 minutes. Costs 2 Mana.

Wind.name: Move
Wind.description: Move a small object a # of feet = to your Power. Costs 1 Mana.

Electricity.name: Lightning
Electricity.description: Call forth a great bolt, causing damage = to your Power to everyone in a 20 ft radius (or more if in water). Must be outdoors. Double damage for targets wearing metal. Maximum distance = Magic. Costs 3 Mana.

Electricity.name: Spark
Electricity.description: Cast a small arc of electricity towards someone, shocking them for as many turns as they fail a Power vs. Constitution roll.

Electricity.name: Surge
Electricity.description: On touch, cause damage = to Power. Costs 1 Mana.

Electricity.name: Supercharge
Electricity.description: Charge reflexes on touch, granting a bonus = to Power to all Agility tasks for 10 minutes. Costs 3 Mana.

Electricity.name: Manipulate electronic
Electricity.description: Force an electronic to turn off, surge, or explode. Damage of explosion is always 4. Costs 2 Mana.
